problem: The browser currently presents editable operator, role and tenant fields as API authority.
desiredOutcome: A qualified/default web build consumes a server-resolved tenant-bound session and fails closed without one.
currentEvidence: apps/api/src/operator-identity.ts verifies signed claims and replay

stack.api: Fastify + TypeScript + existing trusted HMAC resolver
stack.persistence: in-memory local session store for controlled tests only

boundaries.trust: browser is untrusted; API resolver and session store are authority
boundaries.authorization: API route and persistence/RLS enforce actor/role/resource/tenant
boundaries.data: opaque HttpOnly session plus minimal read-only identity snapshot
boundaries.clientServer: browser sends cookie credentials; server resolves identity
boundaries.replay: one-use bootstrap jti; no bearer reuse after bootstrap

candidates.name: browser-decoded claims
candidates.reason: browser is not an authentication boundary

candidates.name: fresh token per request
candidates.reason: external issuer/refresh and concurrency ownership required

candidates.name: opaque server session after one-use bootstrap
candidates.reason: minimum design preserving current replay fence

selectedDesign.name: one-use trusted bootstrap plus opaque HttpOnly server session
selectedDesign.failure: missing/invalid/expired/revoked authority locks the UI and denies protected API operations

verification.E1: bundle/config has no editable authority controls in trusted mode
verification.E4: API boundary and synthetic browser tests

handoffs: G21-5: real IdP/BFF/session authority, key custody, cookie/CSRF policy, durable revocation and browser matrix
revalidationTriggers: change to trusted resolver replay semantics
introduction of a real IdP or durable session store
UI authorization decision or tenant model change
